review: pending: every rule must be reviewed by a clinician on the team before the video is recorded. Reason texts paraphrase the cited guideline; they are not new medical advice.
semantics: A rule fires when ALL of these hold: encounter.group is in rule.groups; every id in when.all is in encounter.symptoms; if when.any is given, at least one id in when.any is in encounter.symptoms; every key in when.answers equals encounter.answers[key]; min_gest_weeks <= encounter.gest_weeks; days_postpartum_max >= encounter.days_postpartum; child_age_months_lt > encounter.child_age_months; if when.bp is given, encounter.bp.sys >= bp.sys_gte OR encounter.bp.dia >= bp.dia_gte (no BP reading = the bp condition fails). A missing gest_weeks, days_postpartum or child_age_months counts as MEETING that condition (safer to refer) and the question is listed as unanswered. Final urgency = highest urgency among fired rules (order below). If nothing fires and any symptom chunk was 'uncertain', urgency = ask_clinic. If nothing fires at all, urgency = home_care_followup.
intent_threshold_note: The confidence threshold lives in public/models/intent_model.json (currently 0.40).

reason.en: Child has a general danger sign (convulsions, cannot drink or breastfeed, vomits everything, or very sleepy). Urgent referral.
reason.sw: Mtoto ana dalili ya hatari (degedege, hawezi kunywa au kunyonya, anatapika kila kitu, au amelegea). Rufaa ya haraka.

reason.en: Child with fever needs a malaria test and assessment today.
reason.sw: Mtoto mwenye homa anahitaji kipimo cha malaria na uchunguzi leo.

reason.en: Child with cough or fast or difficult breathing needs assessment for pneumonia today.
reason.sw: Mtoto mwenye kikohozi au kupumua haraka au kwa shida anahitaji uchunguzi wa nimonia leo.

rules.section: Does the child have cough or difficult breathing?

reason.en: Child with diarrhoea needs a dehydration check. ORS and zinc as the guideline says.
reason.sw: Mtoto anayeharisha anahitaji kuchunguzwa upungufu wa maji. ORS na zinki kama mwongozo unavyoelekeza.

reason.en: Pregnancy danger sign (bleeding, fits, severe abdominal pain or difficult breathing). Go to hospital now.
reason.sw: Dalili ya hatari ya ujauzito (damu, degedege, maumivu makali ya tumbo au kupumua kwa shida). Nenda hospitali sasa.

reason.en: After 20 weeks, headache, vision problems or swelling need a blood pressure and urine check today.
reason.sw: Baada ya wiki 20, maumivu ya kichwa, matatizo ya kuona au kuvimba vinahitaji kipimo cha shinikizo la damu na mkojo leo.

reason.en: Severe headache with vision problems after 20 weeks. Go to hospital now.
reason.sw: Maumivu makali ya kichwa pamoja na matatizo ya kuona baada ya wiki 20. Nenda hospitali sasa.

reason.en: Blood pressure 140/90 or higher after 20 weeks. Needs urine protein test and review today.
reason.sw: Shinikizo la damu 140/90 au zaidi baada ya wiki 20. Anahitaji kipimo cha protini kwenye mkojo leo.

reason.en: Severely raised blood pressure (160/110 or higher). Go to hospital now.
reason.sw: Shinikizo la damu liko juu sana (160/110 au zaidi). Nenda hospitali sasa.

reason.en: Fever in pregnancy needs a malaria test and review today. Do not self-treat.
reason.sw: Homa wakati wa ujauzito inahitaji kipimo cha malaria na uchunguzi leo. Usijitibu.

reason.en: Baby moving less than usual. Needs a check today.
reason.sw: Mtoto tumboni anacheza kidogo kuliko kawaida. Anahitaji kuchunguzwa leo.

reason.en: Heavy bleeding after birth. Go to hospital now.
reason.sw: Damu nyingi baada ya kujifungua. Nenda hospitali sasa.

reason.en: Fever with foul-smelling discharge after birth. Go to hospital now.
reason.sw: Homa pamoja na uchafu wenye harufu mbaya baada ya kujifungua. Nenda hospitali sasa.

reason.en: Fever or discharge after birth needs review today.
reason.sw: Homa au uchafu baada ya kujifungua unahitaji uchunguzi leo.

reason.en: Headache, vision problems or fits in the 6 weeks after birth need a blood pressure check today.
reason.sw: Maumivu ya kichwa, matatizo ya kuona au degedege ndani ya wiki 6 baada ya kujifungua yanahitaji kipimo cha shinikizo la damu leo.

reason.en: Fits after birth. Go to hospital now.
reason.sw: Degedege baada ya kujifungua. Nenda hospitali sasa.

reason.en: Low mood or grief that affects daily life. Offer a supportive follow-up with a health worker.
reason.sw: Huzuni au majonzi yanayoathiri maisha ya kila siku. Mpangie ufuatiliaji na mhudumu wa afya.

reason.en: She has had thoughts of harming herself. Same-day support from a health worker. Stay with her and do not leave her alone.
reason.sw: Amekuwa na mawazo ya kujidhuru. Apate msaada wa mhudumu wa afya leo. Kaa naye, usimwache peke yake.

reason.en: Fever not cleared by malaria treatment. Test before any more antimalarials; other causes need checking.
reason.sw: Homa haijaisha baada ya dawa za malaria. Apimwe kabla ya kupewa dawa nyingine za malaria; visababishi vingine vichunguzwe.

rules.section: Malaria: confirm diagnosis before treatment; fever of unknown origin

reason.en: Fever with livestock contact or raw milk. Infections caught from animals should be checked.
reason.sw: Homa pamoja na kugusana na mifugo au maziwa yasiyochemshwa. Maambukizi kutoka kwa wanyama yachunguzwe.

reason.en: Fever with rats, flood water or muddy fields. Leptospirosis should be checked.
reason.sw: Homa pamoja na panya, maji ya mafuriko au mashamba ya matope. Leptospirosis ichunguzwe.

reason.en: Fever with rash. Check vaccination status; suspected measles must be reported.
reason.sw: Homa pamoja na vipele. Angalia hali ya chanjo; surua inayoshukiwa lazima iripotiwe.

reason.en: Watery diarrhoea with vomiting. Start oral rehydration and check for cholera if cases are rising.
reason.sw: Kuharisha maji pamoja na kutapika. Anza ORS na chunguza kipindupindu kama wagonjwa wanaongezeka.

reason.en: Cough for 2 weeks or more needs a TB test.
reason.sw: Kikohozi cha wiki 2 au zaidi kinahitaji kipimo cha TB.

reason.en: Blood pressure has never been checked. Many adults with high blood pressure do not know it. Book a check.
reason.sw: Shinikizo la damu halijawahi kupimwa. Watu wazima wengi wenye shinikizo la juu hawajui. Mpangie kipimo.

reason.en: Blood pressure 140/90 or higher. Needs a repeat reading and review.
reason.sw: Shinikizo la damu 140/90 au zaidi. Anahitaji kupimwa tena na kuchunguzwa.

outbreak.method: Per ward and syndrome: flag when this week's count >= min_count AND count > mean + sd_multiplier * SD (population SD) of the previous baseline_weeks (EARS-style). A human approves before any escalation.
outbreak.notifiable_note: Verify this list against Tanzania's current IDSR technical guidelines before the demo.

guidance.en: Ask about measles vaccination. Isolate the patient from other children. Report each suspected case immediately to the district surveillance officer.
guidance.sw: Uliza kuhusu chanjo ya surua. Mtenge mgonjwa na watoto wengine. Ripoti kila mgonjwa anayeshukiwa mara moja kwa afisa ufuatiliaji wa wilaya.

guidance.en: Start oral rehydration. Ask about water source. Report suspected cholera immediately to the district surveillance officer.
guidance.sw: Anza ORS. Uliza chanzo cha maji. Ripoti kipindupindu kinachoshukiwa mara moja kwa afisa ufuatiliaji wa wilaya.

syndromes.en: Fever not cleared by malaria treatment
syndromes.sw: Homa isiyoisha baada ya dawa za malaria

guidance.en: Test before giving more antimalarials. Consider leptospirosis, brucellosis, typhoid and rickettsial infection. Ask about animals, rats and flood water.
guidance.sw: Pima kabla ya kutoa dawa zaidi za malaria. Fikiria leptospirosis, brucellosis, homa ya matumbo na rickettsia. Uliza kuhusu wanyama, panya na maji ya mafuriko.

guidance.en: Ask about sick or aborting animals and raw milk. Inform the district veterinary officer as well as the surveillance officer (One Health).
guidance.sw: Uliza kuhusu wanyama wagonjwa au waliotupa mimba na maziwa yasiyochemshwa. Mjulishe afisa mifugo wa wilaya pamoja na afisa ufuatiliaji.
